title: Streamlined microcopy workflow — brainlet
content:
Context and intent:

Quick dump of an idea to make it easier for PMs, PDs, and copywriters to ship consistent, short in-product microcopy for conversation surfaces (assistant prompts, buttons like "Regenerate", taglines, short system messages). Right now copy lives in PRs, handoffs, figma notes, and scattered docs. Pain: mismatches across flows, last-minute tone drift, and engineers hardcoding strings.

Problem statement (one line):
We need a lightweight, low-friction authoring and delivery flow for short UX copy that fits into the existing product pipeline without creating extra cycles for design/dev.

Goals (what success looks like):
- Single source of truth for short voice snippets used by runtime + console + docs
- Easy for non-engineers to propose and iterate on microcopy (preview + accept)
- Track changes and who approved what (audit for legal/compliance)
- Minimal engineering lift: prefer config / content maps over deploys
- Reduce copy-related production rollbacks by 80% in 90 days

Constraints / guardrails:
- Keep latency/size impact tiny (strings only)
- No user PII in stored microcopy templates
- Support placeholders ({{model_name}}, {{user_name}}) but avoid complex templating logic
- Must interoperate with both Hosted API and Dedicated/Private (i.e., allow customer overrides in Private deployments)

Proposed components (sketch):
1) Microcopy registry (json/yaml store)
   - Keyed by product-area, surface, variant, locale. e.g. conversations/initial_prompt/short/en-US
   - Fields: id, text, tone_hint (casual/formal), author, approver, version, created_at
   - Storage: prefer existing config store (S3 + metadata in metadata-service) or a small DB table

2) Editor in Console (minimal):
   - Simple list view with search + filters (surface/locale)
   - Inline edit, preview button (shows in a mocked conversation bubble), propose change -> reviewer flow
   - Approve -> increments version and writes metadata link to audit log

3) Localized workflow:
   - CSV export/import for translators (columns: id, source, translation, notes)
   - Track translation status per locale

4) Runtime integration approach:
   - SDK / API reads microcopy map at bootstrap or caches from edge; supports TTL and local override map
   - For Hosted: console pushes new versions to CDN (fast-ish) + invalidation
   - For Private: customers can mount override file (yaml) into their config; provide script to validate format

User stories (rough):
- As a PM, I want to update the "fallback apology" text so users get a clearer next step, without opening an infra ticket.
- As a copywriter, I want to preview the new microcopy in-situ so I can gauge rhythm/tone.
- As an SRE, I want microcopy loads to have a TTL and fallback behavior so a bad push doesn't break UI.
- As a compliance reviewer, I want to see who approved the message and when so we can answer audits.

Success metrics (initial):
- Adoption: 30 unique microcopy edits in first 60 days across teams
- Reliability: 99.9% UI reads succeed (cache fallback)
- Reduce rollbacks: copy-related rollback incidents down by 80% vs prior quarter
- Time-to-ship: average time from edit proposal to live < 48 hours for Hosted flows

Wire / flow notes (very rough):
- Console: Microcopy > search/filter > open id > preview pane (conversation mock) > propose edit (reason, screenshot optional) > reviewer queue
- Reviewer: quick approve or request changes + comment + set target deployment TTL
- Runtime: client SDK fetch / local cache / environment variable override for private deploys

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Registry exists and can store 5000 unique keys
- Console editor can list, filter, edit, and submit approvals
- Runtime SDK supports a read & cache path + override hook
- Basic audit trail (author, approver, timestamp) stored and retrievable

Open questions / risks (parking lot):
- Who owns tone policy? legal/brand should sign-off — need a short checklist in console (e.g., no medical claims, no PII)
- How to handle dynamic placeholders safely (avoid injection)
- Translation workflow: use existing vendor tooling or build CSV bridge? cost tradeoffs
- Private customers: do we allow Redwood to push microcopy updates? (likely no — need explicit opt-in)
- Edge cases: message length limits across small UI components; we should validate max length per surface

Implementation sketch (phased):
Phase 0: proto store + static admin UI (internal only) + SDK read path hardcoded to dev bucket (1 sprint)
Phase 1: console editor, approve flow, TTL-based CDN publish (2–3 sprints)
Phase 2: i18n integration + private-override tooling + audit export (2 sprints)
Phase 3: automation: linting rules, brand-tone suggestions (stretch)

Notes to self / TODOs: 
- Check with Legal (Lina) about audit fields and retention (ask: retention 7 years?)
- Sync with Console infra (Marco) re: CDN invalidation costs
- Quick spike: mock SDK fetch + fallback in a tiny React demo (use existing theme tokens)
- Add short glossary of surfaces and max-length constraints (map to front-end components)

Random rough phrases / voice ideas to capture in registry: 
- friendly-short: "Oops — didn't get that. Try rephrasing?"
- formal-apology: "We couldn't complete that request. Please try again later."
- action-confirm: "Your settings were saved."

This is intentionally rough. Mostly capturing the idea so I don't forget details and can show Marco / Lina a prototype.

Next steps:
- Draw a tiny demo in Figma (I will stub 2 states: default + updated microcopy)
- Wire up a fake registry endpoint and plumb into the dev playground UI
- Schedule 30-min sync with Marco + Lina (propose Tue Aug 20)

-- end --
